$comment: Platform profiles (writer.md §7). Limits carry headroom. No links anywhere, no hashtags in posts. Change a number here and in the latest migration's platform_profile(); check:contracts compares them.

profiles.label: X
profiles.tone: Short: one point, the plain true line first; under 100 characters is fine. Line breaks only between thoughts. People scroll fast and reply to specifics, not to questions asked for replies.

profiles.label: Threads
profiles.tone: Conversational, as if talking to one person: looser and warmer than X, a few short lines are fine. Personal and behind-the-scenes posts land; polished marketing reads as an ad.

profiles.label: LinkedIn
profiles.tone: Longer, short paragraphs, the first line before the cut (about 140 characters on a phone, 210 on a desktop). A real story or lesson with its details. No "I'm excited to announce", no one-line paragraphs stacked for drama, no moral at the end.

profiles.label: Instagram caption
profiles.tone: The hook in the first line.

profiles.label: YouTube title and description
profiles.tone: A searchable title; the description says what the video shows.
